text: U.S. private employment rises by 90,000 in September. Service providers add 59,000 jobs and goods producers add 31,000, while financial and professional services contract. Firms with 50-499 workers account for 54,000 additions.

meta.note: ADP measures private payrolls and is distinct from the forthcoming BLS employment report.

text: August PCE inflation stands at 3.4% YoY and 0.3% MoM, while core PCE stands at 3.0% YoY and 0.2% MoM. Both annual readings are below consensus estimates but remain above the Fed's 2% target. Revised BEA methodology lowers July core PCE by 0.36 percentage point.

meta.note: Methodological revisions alter prior core readings, limiting direct comparison with earlier releases.

text: Eli Lilly's Phase 2 regimen combines eloralintide with tirzepatide, spanning amylin, GLP-1 and GIP pathways. The highest-dose combination records 23.3% average weight loss versus 14.8% for tirzepatide alone, alongside higher treatment discontinuation rates.

meta.note: Efficacy and discontinuation measures coexist within the same mid-stage trial configuration.

text: The Federal Reserve inspector general identifies management and oversight failures in its headquarters renovation and roughly $1 billion in cost growth. The review finds no reasonable grounds for a federal criminal referral and makes no misconduct finding regarding Jerome Powell's testimony.

meta.note: Administrative failures and the criminal threshold remain distinct findings within the same review.

text: The Pentagon establishes Project Meridian as a 120-day capability review led by technology chief Emil Michael with Elon Musk, Palmer Luckey and Newt Gingrich as co-leads. Government, industry, academia and policy participants share the review structure.

meta.note: Private-sector co-leads include executives whose companies hold Defense Department contracts.

text: Google introduces Gemini 4 Argon with expanded coding, cybersecurity and professional-task capability. Initial access is limited to trusted cybersecurity partners while Google conducts pre-release evaluations with the U.S. government and expands safeguards before public release.

meta.note: Internal Google use and restricted external access coexist before broader public availability.

text: Meta shares rise 27% in September, their strongest monthly gain since 2022. Muse expands across consumer and small-business surfaces while Meta adds an enterprise platform unit and AI hardware, concentrating multiple AI products within its broader business structure.

meta.note: The equity move coincides with several AI launches and organizational changes rather than a single disclosed event.
